pick.headline: Nagorno-Karabakh votes to join Armenia
pick.summary: On 20 February 1988 the regional soviet of Nagorno-Karabakh, an Armenian-majority enclave in Azerbaijan, asked to be transferred to Soviet Armenia.
pick.significance: The vote launched the first of the ethnic conflicts that would tear the Soviet Union apart, and a war between Armenia and Azerbaijan.
